```{r}
library(gtools)  # stars.pval() を使う場合[web:114][web:117]
y_var <- "nt_ch_haz"

make_formula_set <- function(vars, y_var, covariates) {
  rhs <- paste(c(vars, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  as.formula(paste(y_var, "~", rhs))
}

sets <- list(
  food_vars_nt = c("nt_grains", "nt_root", "nt_nuts", 
               "nt_meatfish", "nt_milk", "nt_dairy", "nt_eggs", "nt_vita", 
               "nt_frtveg"),
  food_vars_mdd    = c("nt_mdd"),
  food_vars_log1p1 = food_vars_log1p1,   # ここはすでに一致している
  food_vars_log1p2 = food_vars_log1p2
)


formulas <- lapply(sets, make_formula_set, y_var = y_var, covariates = covariates)
models   <- lapply(formulas, svyglm, design = mySvy)  # svyglm を 4 本（各セット1本）

results <-
  imap_dfr(models, function(mod, nm) {
    tt <- tidy(mod)
    # 元の変数名パターンで term をフィルタ（factor は "nt_mddYes" のように展開される）
    pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(sets[[nm]], collapse = "|"), ")")
    tt %>%
      filter(str_detect(term, pattern)) %>%
      select(term, estimate, p.value) %>%
      mutate(model_set = nm)
  })

results_formatted <-
  results |>
  mutate(
    # 係数を小数点3桁に整形
    estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
    # p値から星を生成（***, **, *, . , ""）
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),
  ) |>
  select(model_set, term, estimate_fmt, sig)

results_formatted
```
